description: Close one of your open signals. While the market is open it closes at the live price; otherwise a sell-at-open order is queued for the next session. A signal that never got an entry price is canceled instead. Closing is final and stays on your record; closing an already closed signal returns an error.

signal_id.description: Signal id from publish_signal or list_my_signals.
signal_id.title: Signal Id

name: close_signal
title: Close a signal
